package.description: A fast, native desktop client for PostgreSQL and other databases.

en-US.description: A fast, native desktop client for PostgreSQL and other databases.
en-US.longDescription:
l8db is a fast, native desktop client for PostgreSQL and other databases.
It covers table browsing with filtering and inline editing, schema inspection,
a Monaco-based SQL editor with history and saved queries, EXPLAIN visualization,
ER diagrams, roles and privileges, partitioning, logical replication, sessions
and locks, SSL/TLS per connection, SSH tunnels and OS keychain secrets.
en-US.name: l8db
